edges.reason: claimOwnership requires msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_; a leaked/pending owner address can claim ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
onlyOwner modifier gates updateCPTemplate on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
onlyOwner modifier gates setFreezeDuration on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
onlyOwner modifier gates setCalmDuration on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
onlyOwner modifier gates setVestDuration on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
onlyOwner modifier gates setCliffRate on msg.sender == _OWNER_.
initCrowdPooling is external with no owner/creator check, so any msg.sender can initialize pools and poison registries.
initOwner sets _INITIALIZED_ = true.
initOwner writes _OWNER_ = newOwner; guard is only notInitialized so initialization can be front-run.
transferOwnership stores newOwner into _NEW_OWNER_.
claimOwnership overwrites _OWNER_ with msg.sender-controlled _NEW_OWNER_.
claimOwnership resets _NEW_OWNER_ to address(0) after the privileged ownership change.
createCrowdPooling reads _CLONE_FACTORY_ as the clone call target.
createCrowdPooling reads _CP_TEMPLATE_ as the prototype to clone.
createCrowdPooling invokes ICloneFactory.clone via external call.
initCrowdPooling performs an external call into an attacker-controlled contract before updating its own registry state.
initCrowdPooling executes valueList[0] = uint112(-1), an unchecked truncating cast.
_REGISTRY_ is written only after the external init call, enabling reentrant registry corruption.
_USER_REGISTRY_ is written only after the external init call, enabling reentrant registry corruption.
initCrowdPooling reads _DVM_FACTORY_ into addressList[6].
initCrowdPooling reads _DEFAULT_MAINTAINER_ into addressList[1].
initCrowdPooling reads _DEFAULT_MT_FEE_RATE_MODEL_ into addressList[5].
initCrowdPooling reads _DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MANAGER_ into addressList[4].

valueCheck requires timeLine[2] <= _CALM_DURATION_.
valueCheck requires timeLine[4] == _VEST_DURATION_.
valueCheck requires valueList[3] == _CLIFF_RATE_.
